name: Git
description: Git as in IntelliJ IDEA: Local Changes with a commit box (amend, commit and push, a message written by the assistant), Shelf, Stash, a Log with the branch graph and every commit action (cherry-pick, revert, reset, edit message, fixup, squash, drop, new branch or tag), branches, and a Console of the git commands run. Diffs open as tabs in the documents' place, side by side.
